rationale: Frozen objective: minimize one sync-bracketed batch-32 FP32 ResNet-18 forward on a single leased GPU, with a 0.95 throughput floor and exact-top1/logits quality gates. Evidence: observations.json marks communication not_applicable (single-device task); the torch collector already ran with complete attribution (coverage.json: 46/46 kernels associated, 0 unassociated, 0 ambiguous forward sequences, 0 autograd ranges, inference-only). The open diagnostic question for latency is decomposing the measured wall-clock into GPU kernel execution versus host-side dispatch/launch overhead (CPU-submit vs GPU-execute overlap). nsys is available (request.json tools.nsys, listed in available-collectors.json) and resolves exactly this overlap/gap question via CUDA API and kernel timelines; it is selected for that purpose only, not for attribution (already complete) or communication bucket identity (no communication exists). python_runtime is selected to locate which host frames (transformers/torch bindings across the 46-kernel Python-driven forward) drive dispatch cost where gaps appear, accepting that it perturbs execution and its inclusive/self times are diagnostic readings, not clean performance scores or GPU compute durations. Excluded: torch (already ran, full coverage, not re-requested); execution_timeline (its plain Torch trace, CPU-to-CUDA submit associations, synchronization and per-device intervals duplicate the completed torch coverage plus nsys, its gradient post-accumulate callbacks are inapplicable to inference, and it cannot bound GPU readiness/consumer completion beyond what nsys timelines already give, so it never informs subsequent search actions here); nccl_tuning, collective_calibration, device_telemetry (no communication in the measured unit, host-to-device transfer is outside the timed bracket, and per-collective bytes/protocol are unobservable); candidate_diagnostics and binding_cost (no candidate exists yet). No PCIe/NVLink traffic is inferred from payload or memcpy sizes, and nsys timelines are not used to prove bucket identity.
